title: Strudel Dough
author: Beila
instructions: Beat together butter, sour cream, and eggs.
Add flour, maizena, baking powder, and sugar. Mix to dough.
Roll out dough.
Spread apricot jam.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar.
Roll into sausages.
Brush with egg wash and sprinkle sugar.
Bake at 180°.
Cut into slices.
notes: Temp 180°. Use 4 jumbo eggs.

title: Short Bread Biscuits
instructions: Set oven to 350°.
Cream Butter and sugar.
Add rest of ingredients.
Press into greased tin.
Pierce dough.
Bake till golden brown (approx 20 mins).
Cut while hot.
notes: Card number: +1 310 345 6426.

title: Lamb Marinade
author: Caron Melamed
instructions: Combine mint, coriander, oil, lemon juice, cloves, chillies, paprika, and salt for Marinade.
Combine capers, coriander, onion, Yelenia, chopped chilli, mint jelly, lemon juice for Sauce.
notes: Handwritten number: 7286812.

title: Rice Krispy Biscuits
instructions: Melt butter in saucepan.
Add marshmallows, stir until melted.
Remove from heat, stir in Rice Krispies.
Press into greased tray.
Refrigerate until firm, then cut.
notes: 6 Cups = 350g box.

title: Asparagus Pie
instructions: Rub butter into dry ingredients.
Add milk to form dough. Press into dish.
Fry onions and garlic.
Spread on pastry, cover with asparagus.
Beat cream, fold in egg and mayo.
Pour over asparagus, sprinkle cheese.
Bake at 420-425 for 20 mins.

title: Peppermint Crisp Tart
instructions: Beat Orley whip.
Soften Treat in microwave, beat smooth.
Layer biscuits in dish.
Layer Treat, then Orley Whip, then grated chocolate.
Repeat layers.
Refrigerate.

title: Gazpacho Soup
instructions: Chop all vegetables.
Add all ingredients together.
Serve with garnishes.
notes: Abbreviations: ten=can, T=Tbsp.

title: Teiglach (Original)
instructions: Mix ingredients to soft dough.
Form balls.
Boil syrup ingredients together.
notes: This appears to be the uncorrected version.

title: Cheese Cake
author: Beila
instructions: Prepare crumb base.
Combine cheese, cream, sugar, vanilla, lemon.
Mix well.
Mix in flour.
Add eggs one at a time.
Bake 180° for 30 mins.
Turn off oven, leave 10 mins.
Open door, cool.

title: Cioccolatissimo
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter.
Beat eggs, yolks, sugar. Add flour.
Mix batters.
Grease moulds.
Bake 190° for 7 mins.
notes: Self-saucing pudding.

title: Mint Brownies
instructions: Mix base ingredients.
Prepare filling with icing sugar/essence.
Top with melted chocolate/margarine.

title: Teiglach (Corrected)
instructions: Combine dough ingredients.
Form balls.
Boil syrup ingredients.
notes: Contains handwritten corrections (reduced eggs/oil).

title: Provencal Lamb Potjie
instructions: Brown lamb, set aside.
Brown veggies.
Return all to pot (except tomato/lemon).
Bake 160° for 3 hours.
Add sun-dried tomatoes and lemon for last hour.
notes: Can be simmered on stove.

title: Mathilda's Torte
author: Dianne
instructions: Cream butter and sugar, add almonds.
Line 2 pans with foil.
Spread mixture, bake 180° until brown.
Cool, peel foil.
Sandwich layers with cream mixture.

title: Semolina and Coconut Cake
instructions: Mix cake ingredients.
Bake 180° for 30-40 mins.
Boil syrup.
Prick cake, pour syrup.

title: Fruit Salad
instructions: Mix all together.
Bake in Pyrex dish at 180° for 1 hour.

title: Honey Cake
instructions: Boil honey and water, cool.
Beat eggs and oil.
Add sugar.
Add dry ingredients alternating with honey.
Bake 160° for 1 hour.

title: LASAGNE
instructions: Chop 10 Onions (for meat sauce).
Brown the chopped onion and garlic in 1 tsp. + 6 Tablespoons of oil/fat.
Brown the meat (2kg at a time).
Add 15 Bay Leaves.
Add 12 Tablespoon Parsely.
Season the Mince.
Add Tomato Puree.
For the White Sauce: Chop 16 Onions.
Brown the 16 onions in 4 cups Oil.
Break up 26 Chicken Cubes with 36 cups Water (Put on un/low heat).
Separate 30 eggs.
Boil Noodles 2 packets at a time.
Rinse boiled noodles with Cold Water.
notes: Instruction regarding meat preparation specifies: Brown Meat 2kg at a time. The instructions suggest a very large batch.

title: GRILLED FENNEL, CHICORY AND ARTICHOKE SALAD
instructions: Cut fennel bulbs in half and the chicory into long slices.
Remove the leaves from the artichokes and cut the stem and heart in half.
Place these vegetables in a baking tray and drizzle a little olive oil over them.
Add the salt and pepper and roast at 180 for 20 - 25 minutes, until slightly charred.
Place in a shallow platter and decorate with coriander, roasted pine nuts and sundried tomatoes.

title: ROAST BUTTERNUT AND CARAMELIZED PEAR SALAD
ingredients: 1 butternut, peeled and cut into batons
olive oil, salt and pepper (for roasting)
¼ cup balsamic vinegar mixed with 1 tbs sugar (for roasting)
3 tbs olive oil. Sunflower oil mix (for dressing)
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C. Place butternut on a lined baking tray and roast with olive oil, salt and pepper for about 10 minutes (Use the bottom of the oven).
Then turn and brush with the balsamic vinegar mix. Roast for another 5 minutes. Remove from oven. Set aside to cool.
Preheat a frying pan until almost smoking, add a little margarine or butter and sugar and then fry the pear slices in batches. The pan must be very hot.
Remove and cool on baking paper or a liner. Do not stack on top of each other. Set aside.
To make the dressing: Using the same frying pan, boil the balsamic vinegar and reduce by 1/3.
Then add the honey and oil and season with salt and pepper to make a dressing.
TO ASSEMBLE: Place butter lettuce on a platter. Arrange butternut and pear slices on top of lettuce.
Sprinkle with the cranberries, figs, toasted almonds and onion rings. Fan avocado slices in the center of the salad.
Drizzle with dressing just before serving.
notes: To toast the almonds, preheat oven to 140°C. Toast on a baking tray for 10 minutes or until golden. Use Osem (Spar) onion rings. Butternut roasting note: Bottom of over. Caramelized pears cooling note: Don't restack.

title: Danish Herring
author: Eva
notes: Quantity note states: 1 pot = 2 flats = 6 herrings. The handwritten measurements 'tall' and 'teasp' have been interpreted as tablespoon and teaspoon respectively.

title: Strawberry Salad
author: Julia Roz Abromarik
instructions: Prepare a bed of Cos lettuce (or Romaine or butter).
Slice strawberries and arrange them over the lettuce.
Sprinkle over the flaked almonds, sunflower seeds, and pine nuts.
For the dressing, put the apple cider vinegar, sugar, oil, and poppy seeds in a blender and blend.
Throw the dressing over the salad at the last minute before serving.
notes: The writer notes that olive oil is optional for the dressing.

title: Smoked Snoek Pie
ingredients: 8 TBS unsalted butter, very cold (or 5 TBS frozen margarine) (for crust)
1 1/2 tsps cider vinegar or lemon juice (for crust)
instructions: Crust Preparation: Process salt, flour and baking powder in food processor to mix. Add cut up butter. Process until mixture resembles breadcrumbs. Then sprinkle water and vinegar over and process just until a ball starts to form. Shape into a disc. Refrigerate until ready to use.
White Sauce: Melt butter, add the flour mixed with the ½ cup milk and then thicken whilst whisking all the time. Gradually add remaining milk and thicken to make a white sauce.

Filling Assembly: Flake snoek and remove all bones. Mix cottage cheese in with snoek. Add snoek mixture to white sauce. Season to taste. Add a little chopped parsley. Stir in cheddar cheese and adjust seasoning.

Pie Assembly: Spray a small deep pie dish. Roll out half the dough (use a rolling pin to spread dough into the dish). Top with the snoek filling. Roll out remaining half of dough and cover filling, sealing sides. (*If using puff pastry, only use pastry on top of the filling.)
Baking: Preheat oven to 180 C. Brush with beaten egg. Bake on middle rack of oven for about 25-30 minutes or until golden.
notes: Butter amount for white sauce is noted as '½ or 2T'. The crust allows for 5 TBS frozen margarine substitution for butter or lemon juice substitution for vinegar.

title: GRILLED SALMON OR KINGKLIP WITH PONZU SAUCE
ingredients: 1x 800g piece Norwegian Salmon with skin on (or Kingklip)
instructions: Prepare the Ponzu Sauce by combining Orange Juice, White Wine Vinegar, Sugar, Soya Sauce, Fresh Lime Juice, Pinch Chilli Paste (if using), Salt, Pepper, and Water.
Use Maizena to thicken the sauce.
Prepare the salmon or kingklip with Olive Oil, Salt, and Pepper, and grill it.
Toast sesame seeds at 140° for 10 minutes.
Steam the Bok Choy (2-3 minutes in the microwave).
Serve the grilled fish with the Ponzu Sauce and accompaniments.
notes: The Ponzu Sauce is good on chicken too. The recipe specifies Norwegian Salmon with skin on. Maizena amount for thickening is approximately 1 T.

title: THAI CHICKEN CAKES WITH SOYA DIPPING SAUCE
ingredients: 2 TBS FRESH CORIANDER, CHOPPED OR ITALIAN PARSLEY
1 TSP SESAME OIL OR OLIVE OIL
1 TBS SWEET CHILLI SAUCE (for dipping sauce)
instructions: Mix all chicken cake ingredients together.
Heat a small pan quite hot with a drop of olive oil.
Wet hands and gently shape chicken into small flat cakes.
Brown on each side until just cooked through.
For the Soya Dipping Sauce, heat all sauce ingredients together in a small pot until sugar is melted and then cool before serving.
Serve chicken cakes with soya dipping sauce.
Reheat chicken cakes on 100 C for about 10 minutes lightly covered or until warmed through.
notes: Makes about 10 small bite size cakes.

title: SHREDDED VEAL OR BEEF SHANKS WITH RIGATONI
ingredients: 4 KG WHOLE VEAL OR BEEF SHANKS
instructions: Season veal very well with salt and pepper. Brown in a little olive oil on all sides in a heavy-bottom pot. Set aside.
In the same pot, sauté sliced leeks, celery, carrots and garlic in a little more olive oil.
Place meat back in the pot and pour over the tomatoes, red wine, beef stock, parsley and thyme.
Cover with the lid and simmer for at least 3 hours on medium heat.
Meat should be falling off the bone. Taste for seasoning.
When very soft, remove meat from bones and shred with a knife and fork. Place back in the sauce.
Cook pasta. Place pasta in a shallow dish and top with finely shredded veal.
notes: Celery should be cut big.

title: Chilled Cherry Tomato Soup with Avocado and Basil Oil
instructions: Cut cherry tomatoes in half. Place both kinds in a food processor and process until chopped.
Add tomato juice and remaining ingredients. Season well with salt and pepper.
Chill before serving.
Prepare the Basil Oil: Place basil in a food processor and process with olive oil (1/3 cup) and salt.
To serve: Combine the chopped avocado and 1/2 English cucumber.
Squeeze the garnish with fresh lemon juice.
Drizzle the basil oil into the soup.
notes: Must be served cold. Use red onion, spring onion, or shallots. Use a drop of lemon juice on the avocado to stop discoloration.

title: GINGER CAKE WITH GINGER SAUCE
instructions: Preheat oven to 160 C. Spray a lamington tin or small roasting pan. Set aside.
Mix dry ingredients together and set aside in a bowl.
Beat oil, molasses and dark brown sugar.
Add eggs and then the lemon rind. Beat well then add the chopped ginger.
Stir in the dry ingredients and the boiling water alternately. Beat again.
Bake about 30 minutes or until set.
For the Sauce: Boil all sauce ingredients on medium heat until thickened.
Pour sauce over cake immediately after removing from oven.
Turn oven off and put back into the oven for 10 minutes.
Serve warm.
notes: Handwritten note indicates 'treacle sugar' next to the dark brown sugar ingredient.

title: CRUMBED CHICKEN BREASTS (SERVE WITH TOMATO CHILLI JAM)
ingredients: 8 SUN DRIED TOMATOES (KOSHER-INA PAARMAN IN VINAIGRETTE, DRAINED)
2 TBS CHOPPED CHIVES OR SPRING ONIONS
½ TSP CHILLI PASTE OR 1 RED CHILLI
2 RED CHILLIES OR 1 TSP CHILLI PASTE
instructions: Marinate chicken breasts in a bottle of salad dressing for a few hours.
Place all remaining ingredients (for the crumb mixture) in food processor, except crumbs. Process until finely minced. Then add crumbs, and pulse to mix in. Set aside.
Place cherry tomatoes, ginger, chillies and garlic (for the jam) in food processor. Process until finely chopped.
Place in a heavy-bottom pot and add sugar, red wine vinegar and salt. Boil uncovered for at least 30-40 minutes until thickened. Mixture should still be a little soft as it thickens when it cools.
After marinating chicken breasts, preheat oven to 200 C.
Dip breasts into crumb mixture. Place on exopat/mat skin side up and bake uncovered for exactly 25 minutes or until breasts are firm.
Serve with tomato chilli jam.
notes: The salad dressing used was 'Igrais gren's'. The sun-dried tomatoes used were Kosher-Ina Paarman. Handwritten note mentions '20 mins no skin' related to the chicken. Note on baking: If cooking legs and thigh, precook 20 minutes in oven without the crumbs, then dip into crumbs and bake for a further 20-25mins.

title: Shell Pasta with Roasted Tomato Sauce and Basil Oil
ingredients: 1 box Shell Pasta (Conchiglione or Delverde Conchiglione Rigate) - boiled "al dente"
2 punnets Bella Tomatoes or 1 bag Roma Tomatoes (cut in half)
instructions: Preheat oven to 220 C.
Drizzle Bella or Roma tomatoes with olive oil, salt and pepper and roast them uncovered for 30 -40 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Place rosa tomatoes in same roasting pan, drizzle with oil, season them, add basil and roast for about 15 minutes or until they just pop open.
Mash Bella tomatoes lightly with a fork to make a sauce.
Sprinkle with sugar. Adjust seasoning.
Mix both tomato mixtures together and refrigerate until ready to use.
notes: Pasta should be from Woolworths (Conchiglione or Delverde Conchiglione Rigate).

title: Pareve Apple Cinnamon Cake
author: Sharon Glass
ingredients: 3 whole eggs and 3 yolks (6 eggs total)
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 C.
Spray a large chiffon cake tin, or 2 layer tins (26cm each).
Beat eggs and yolks with sugar until frothy.
Add oil and continue beating and then add the boiling water.
Add self raising flour. Beat a little more and then set aside.
Beat whites until stiff and then add the 2 TBS sugar.
Fold whites into egg yolk mixture and set aside.
Mix cinnamon and sugar together.
Pour half of batter into the tin.
Sprinkle with 3/4 of the grated apple and 3/4 of the cinnamon sugar.
Marble into the batter with a knife.
Pour remaining batter into the tin.
Mix remaining cinnamon-sugar with Cardin and 1 TBS potato starch.
Add remaining grated apple.
Spread over top of batter.
Dot with sliced apples.
Reduce oven temp. to 160 C.
Bake 55 minutes. Turn oven off and leave cake in the oven for another 20 minutes.
Cool in the tin. Turn out onto a platter.
notes: Recipe from Sharon Glass Cooking School. Handwritten note next to flour: 'Osem'. Use large chiffon cake tin or 2 layer tins (26cm each).

title: Broccoli Coleslaw with Red Pepper, Mango and Toasted Sunflower Seeds
ingredients: 2 packets broccoli, blanched, stems julienned (or 1 kg frozen broccoli)
1 red pepper, cut into thin strips
5 spring onion or shallots, sliced thinly
1 tin mango slices (drained - retain juice), cut into thin strips
instructions: For the dressing: Whisk all ingredients together. Refrigerate until ready to use.
Mix all salad ingredients and dressing together and toss with sunflower seeds just before serving.
notes: Uses Kraft light mayonnaise. Handwritten note at bottom: Verjuice - oils + vinegar.

title: Lamb Shanks with Pomegranate Wine Marinade
ingredients: 4-6 whole Lamb shanks, bone cracked twice
2 cups pomegranate juice (reduced from 2 x 330ml bottles)
instructions: Rub shanks all over with a little olive oil.
Sprinkle with coarse salt and black pepper and some fresh mint.
Roast on the bottom rack of a preheated 180 C oven uncovered for about 1 hour, turning halfway.
Then cover with foil, reduce oven to 160 C, place them in the middle of the oven and cook covered with foil for at least 1-2 hours or until the meat is softened.
Heat some olive oil in a large pot. Saute the onion and minced garlic in the oil until softened. Add black pepper and salt whilst cooking.
Then add the wine, reducing a little.
Pour in the stock, reduced pomegranate juice, brown sugar, balsamic and reduce on medium-high heat until the sauce begins to caramelize.
Season to taste with salt and pepper and stir in the chopped parsley.
After 2 hours (of covered cooking), remove the foil and pour over the pomegranate sauce.
Cook for a further 1 hour with the sauce on to thicken it and flavour the meat.
notes: The 2 cups of pomegranate juice required for the marinade should be achieved by boiling down 2 x 330ml bottles of spring Pomegranate juice.

title: PAREVE CREAM CARAMEL
author: Caron Melamed
instructions: Preheat oven to 160c.
Place 1 cup sugar and water in a heavy pan.
Stir together. Then turn up heat and caramelize without stirring.
Pour caramel into a loaf tin and swirl all around the tin.
Heat milk, cream, and vanilla.
Beat eggs, yolks and 1/2 cup sugar lightly (Whisk).
Beat in heated milk and cream.
Strain custard into loaf tin. Cover loaf tin with tinfoil.
Place loaf tin in a water bath. (Water bath must be heated with the oven. Water should come up half way up the sides of the loaf tin).
Bake for 45 minutes.
Leave to cool. Refrigerate till needed.
Cut around the edge of custard with a knife. Dip tin in boiling water. Flip over.
notes: Can make 2 days in advance - keep in fridge. The pareve milk suggested is Riches Coffee Creamer, and the pareve cream is Riches. Handwritten note during baking: check if centre is cooked.

title: TURKISH DELIGHT ICE CREAM WITH STRAWBERRIES & GRANADILLA
ingredients: 1 box (275 g) plain Turkish Delight (or mix with the ginger one)
instructions: Melt half the box of Turkish delight with the 1/2 cup cream in the microwave. Set aside.
Whip the remaining 1 cup cream (Orly Whip or Rich's) until firm and holding its shape. Set aside.
Beat eggs with the castor sugar until very, very thick and creamy.
Fold all 3 parts together. Pour into a mould (either loaf tin or a spring form tin).
Chop remaining 1/2 box Turkish delight into small pieces and sprinkle on top of ice cream.
Set in freezer until ready to serve.
Serve with strawberries and granadilla pulp.
notes: Cream substitute suggestions include Orly Whip or Rich's. Mould options: loaf tin or a spring form tin.

title: Sticky Spicy Chicken Wing Skewers
instructions: Place 2 wings on each of 2 kebab sticks to secure them (or ask your butcher to do them for you).
Mix all sauce ingredients together.
Brush some over the chicken wings.
Preheat the grill in the oven and grill the wings on the middle to upper rack of the oven until they are charred all over.
They should grill for about 10 minutes each side.
Then lower them to the bottom part of the oven. Continue grilling until they are cooked through.
notes:
The sauce uses Wellingtons brand products (Sweet and Sour, Sweet Chilli Fruity, Sweet Chilli). 

Whole Chicken variation: Spatchcock chicken - flatten it. Brush with the sauce as above and season well. Place in a sprayed roasting pan on the bottom rack of a preheated 180 C oven and roast for 1 1/2 hours or until golden and brown.

title: ROASTED BUTTERNUT AND FETA QUICHE
author: Sharon Glass
ingredients: 500g Butternut, cut into small thin slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 220 C. Place butternut in a roasting pan and drizzle with a little olive oil.
Season with salt and pepper. Roast for 20 minutes or until browned and softened.
CRUST: Place dry ingredients (flours, sugar, salt) in a food processor. Process to mix. Add cut up butter and process until crumbed.
Pulse in water, lemon juice and egg yolk. Process until mixture just forms a ball.
Remove and place in glad wrap in a disc shape and refrigerate for 20 minutes. (If dough is firm, roll out immediately and then place tin in the fridge with the dough).
Preheat oven to 180 C.
Roll out dough and place in a 26cm loose-bottom tart tin or a quiche dish. Line with foil and fill with beans or rice to hold down.
Bake for 15 minutes. Remove foil, beans or rice. Bake for a further 10 minutes uncovered until crust is golden.
FILLING: Place butternut pieces and feta on bottom of crust.
Beat eggs, cream, paprika, melted butter, salt and pepper together.
Pour over feta and butternut. Sprinkle with chopped sage.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until puffed and golden. Serve immediately.
notes: Recipe from Sharon Glass Cooking School. Demonstration: BNOTH ZION FISH DEMONSTRATION 2003.
